headline: Callahan's Passage Breaks Stalemate As Northern Fronts Churn
war_summary: Recent hours have brought fresh structural shifts to previously static sectors, as Callahan's Passage and Mooring County broke into active base turnover with contested changes at Crumbling Post, Scáth Passing, and The Wind Hills. Palantine Berm has reignited rapidly, logging multiple transitions around The Pippeli Stones up to the latest hour, while Kuura Strand maintains heavy churn across Talven and Menneen. Along the primary northern line, Weathered Expanse, Nevish Line, and Stlican Shelf continue to endure severe combat, each recording thousands of casualties and relentless base exchanges at strongpoints such as Crow's Nest and Blackcoat Way. Conversely, Fisherman's Row has quieted following earlier captures, joining Linn of Mercy, Stonecradle, and the vast southern rear areas in relative stillness. Combat operations remain tightly concentrated along the disputed northern tier, where escalating enlistments and high turnover signal sustained pressure across multiple hexes.
